detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

Acetic Acid

Chemical Information:
  • Molecular Formula: C₂H₄O₂
  • Molecular Weight: 60.05 g/mol
  • Chemical Name: Ethanoic acid
  • Compound Class: Carboxylic acid
Molecular Structure:
Product Description

Acetic Acid is a simple organic carboxylic acid commonly used in laboratory and research environments as a chemical reagent, solvent component, and pH-adjusting agent. It is a clear, colorless liquid with a characteristic odor and high miscibility in water and many organic solvents. Acetic acid is produced through chemical synthesis and supplied as a liquid research material. This product is intended exclusively for controlled in vitro research applications conducted by qualified professionals and is not formulated for clinical, diagnostic, or therapeutic use.

Research Applications:
  • In vitro chemical and biochemical assay preparation
  • Laboratory pH adjustment and buffer system development
  • Analytical chemistry method development
  • Organic chemistry reaction studies
  • Comparative evaluation of small-molecule organic acids
Storage and Handling:
  • Store tightly sealed at 20–25 °C
  • Keep container closed when not in use
  • Handle using appropriate laboratory safety procedures
  • Use only in well-ventilated laboratory environments
Product Specifications:
  • Purity: Research grade (refer to Certificate of Analysis)
  • Appearance: Clear, colorless liquid
  • Solubility: Miscible with water
  • Form: Liquid
Compliance Notice:

Acetic Acid is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
